name: Internet-facing Cloud Run with vulnerabilities and data access
description: Cloud Run revision is exposed to the public internet, uses default compute service account (with broad data access), creating a toxic combination of EXTERNAL_EXPOSURE + UNPROTECTED_PRINCIPAL + UNPROTECTED_DATA
remediation: 1. Create a dedicated service account with minimal required permissions. 2. Update the Cloud Run service to use the dedicated service account. 3. Review and restrict data access permissions. 4. Consider restricting ingress to internal-only traffic.
